en: Psalms 109
For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

ja: 指揮者のために。ダビデの詩。

p.src: 1  God of my praise, don’t remain silent,

ja: っていないでください。
en: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
u.src: 1  God of my praise, don’t remain silent,

p.src: 2  for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

en: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.
u.src: 2  for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

p.src: 3  They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

en: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
u.src: 3  They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

p.src: 4  In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

en: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
u.src: 4  In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

p.src: 5  They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

en: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
u.src: 5  They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

p.src: 6  Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

en: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
u.src: 6  Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

p.src: 7  When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

ja: かれるとき、罪ある者とされ、 その祈りさえ
とみなされますように。
en: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.
u.src: 7  When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

p.src: 8  Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

en: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.
u.src: 8  Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

p.src: 9  Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

ja: のない者となり、 その
はやもめとなりますように。
en: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
u.src: 9  Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

p.src: 10  Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

ja: まいから追われますように。
en: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
u.src: 10  Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

p.src: 11  Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

ja: つものをことごとく取り上げ、 見知らぬ者たちが、その労苦の実を
en: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.
u.src: 11  Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

p.src: 12  Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

en: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.
u.src: 12  Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

p.src: 13  Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

en: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
u.src: 13  Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

p.src: 14  Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

en: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
u.src: 14  Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

p.src: 15  Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

en: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;
u.src: 15  Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

p.src: 16  because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

ja: を、 死に至らせるまで追い詰めたからだ。
en: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
u.src: 16  because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

p.src: 17  Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

en: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
u.src: 17  Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

p.src: 18  He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

en: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.
u.src: 18  He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

p.src: 19  Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

ja: のようになりますように。
en: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.
u.src: 19  Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

p.src: 20  This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.

ja: たちへの、主からの報いである。 私に
en: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.
u.src: 20  This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.

p.src: 21  But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

ja: みてください。 あなたの
en: But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
u.src: 21  But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

ja: 109:21 「主」と訳された言葉は「アドナイ」である。
en: 109:21 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”

p.src: 22  for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

en: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
u.src: 22  for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

p.src: 23  I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

ja: り、 いなごのように
en: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
u.src: 23  I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

p.src: 24  My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

en: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
u.src: 24  My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

p.src: 25  I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

en: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.
u.src: 25  I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

p.src: 26  Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

ja: けてください。 あなたの
en: Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;
u.src: 26  Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

p.src: 27  that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.

ja: よ、あなたが行われたのだと、
en: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.
u.src: 27  that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.

p.src: 28  They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

ja: け、 あなたのしもべは
en: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
u.src: 28  They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

p.src: 29  Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

ja: のように身にまといますように。
en: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
u.src: 29  Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

p.src: 30  I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

en: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
u.src: 30  I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

p.src: 31  For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.

en: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
u.src: 31  For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
